SwipeClean Terms of Use

Apple's Standard EULA

SwipeClean is licensed to you, not sold, under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (the "Standard EULA"). The Standard EULA, including its sections on the scope of the license, consent to use of data, termination, warranty disclaimers, limitation of liability, export rules and governing law, applies to SwipeClean. These Terms of Use add app-specific terms. If these terms and the Standard EULA conflict, the Standard EULA controls, except where these terms give you more rights. We (the developer of SwipeClean), not Apple, are responsible for SwipeClean and its support. Apple is a third-party beneficiary of the Standard EULA and may enforce it.

By downloading or using SwipeClean you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the app. Our Privacy Policy explains how data is handled.

Using SwipeClean

SwipeClean helps you review and clean up the photo library on your own iPhone. You need an Apple device running a supported version of iOS and permission to access Photos. Features may differ between versions and may change as we improve the app.

Your photos and deletions

  • You decide what is deleted. Swiping to delete only stages an item in SwipeClean's Review tray. Nothing is removed from Photos until you confirm in the tray and in iOS's own confirmation.
  • Confirmed deletions go to the Photos app's Recently Deleted album, where you can recover them for up to 30 days. After that, or after you empty Recently Deleted, they are gone permanently.
  • With iCloud Photos on, deletions also apply to iCloud, your other devices and any Shared Library.
  • Suggestions such as "duplicate", "similar", "blurry" or "best shot" are automated estimates and can be wrong. Please check before you confirm.
  • Keep a backup of photos that matter to you. We never have a copy of your photos and cannot recover them.

Free version and ads

The free version lets you swipe and sort without limit and delete up to a free allowance shown in the app. It shows ads served by third-party ad networks through AppLovin MAX. We are not responsible for the content of third-party ads or for the websites or apps they link to; ad partners follow their own policies. Rewarded ads may unlock a small bonus described in the app (for example, extra free delete allowance); rewards have no cash value, cannot be transferred and may change.

SwipeClean Pro: subscriptions, free trial and lifetime purchase

The free version of SwipeClean includes ads and the features described in the app as free. SwipeClean Pro unlocks the Pro features and removes ads. Pro is available as:

  • An auto-renewing subscription (yearly, and any other period offered in the app). The yearly plan may include a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, as an Apple introductory offer.
  • A lifetime purchase: a one-time, non-consumable purchase. No renewals.

The price, billing period and trial length are shown in the app before you confirm and in Apple's purchase sheet. Prices vary by country and may include taxes.

How billing works

  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. If you start a free trial, you are not charged during the trial; your Apple ID is charged the subscription price when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.
  • Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends, at the then-current price.
  • You can manage or cancel a subscription at any time in iOS Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions, or from the "Manage subscription" option in the app's Settings. Cancelling stops future renewals; you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for. If you cancel during a free trial, Apple may end your access to Pro right away.
  • Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription or the lifetime purchase.
  • If a price increases, Apple notifies you in advance and, where required, asks for your consent before renewing at the new price.
  • If you have a subscription and later buy the lifetime purchase, cancel the subscription in Settings so you are not charged twice. The app reminds you.
  • Purchases are shareable with up to five other family members through Apple's Family Sharing, where the app says so.

Refunds and restores

All payments are processed by Apple. We cannot see or issue refunds; request one from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. Apple's refund decisions and your statutory rights (for example, EU/UK withdrawal rights for digital content) are handled by Apple under its terms. Use "Restore Purchases" in the app to get Pro back on a new device signed in to the same Apple ID.

Acceptable use

Don't use SwipeClean to break the law or anyone else's rights; don't try to reverse-engineer, tamper with or bypass the app's purchase checks, free allowance or ad systems, except where the law allows this despite this restriction; and don't use automated means to generate fake ad impressions or rewards.

Disclaimers and liability

SwipeClean is provided "as is" and "as available", as described in the Standard EULA. Storage estimates are calculated from the file sizes iOS reports and may differ from what iPhone Storage shows. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for lost photos or data resulting from deletions you confirmed, from iCloud syncing, or from the loss or failure of your device, and our total liability is limited as described in the Standard EULA. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer law in your country that cannot be waived.

Changes

We may update these terms, for example when we add features. We will change the date at the top and, for significant changes, tell you in the app. Continuing to use SwipeClean after a change means you accept the updated terms. Changes never apply retroactively to purchases you already made.
